Settings of CMSY++ and Their Defaults

Source: R/cmsy_settings.R
cmsy_defaults.Rd

This function lists the general settings of the CMSY++ code (the section "General settings for the analysis" of CMSY++16.R and the MCMC settings of its JAGS call), their default values in CMSY++, the values cmsy_run() uses (the defaults, unless changed with its settings argument), what each one does and which part of CMSY++ it affects.

Usage

cmsy_defaults(settings = list(), lang = NULL)

Arguments

settings

Optional named list of changed settings, e.g. list(CV.C = 0.2), to show them next to the defaults and check them.

lang

The language of the description column: "en", "zh" or "both". Default is NULL, the language set with fao_settings().

Value

A data frame with one row per setting: setting, cmsy_default, used, changed, applies_to and description.

Details

Two settings of the code, sigmaR and ni, are set in CMSY++16.R but used nowhere in it: the process error of the model is estimated in JAGS with the prior itau2 ~ dgamma(4, 0.01), so changing sigmaR would not change any result. They are listed as "not used" and cannot be changed, so that a run is not taken for a sensitivity analysis of the process error.

Settings marked "BSM" only matter when abundance data (CPUE or biomass) are given; FAO data have none, so with FAO data alone only the settings marked "all" change the results. The chart and output switches of CMSY++ (mgraphs, kobe.plot, pp.plot, retros, save.plots, write.output, ...) are set by the plots argument of cmsy_run(), and the file names by the run itself.

References

Froese, R., Demirel, N., Coro, G. and Winker, H. (2021). User Guide for CMSY++. GEOMAR, Germany, 17 pp. https://oceanrep.geomar.de/id/eprint/52147/

Examples

# All settings with their CMSY++ defaults
cmsy_defaults()
#>         setting cmsy_default       used changed applies_to
#> 1          CV.C         0.15       0.15   FALSE        all
#> 2       CV.cpue          0.2        0.2   FALSE        BSM
#> 3        sigmaR          0.1        0.1   FALSE   not used
#> 4    cor.log.rk        -0.76      -0.76   FALSE     charts
#> 5   rk.cor.beta   2.52, 3.37 2.52, 3.37   FALSE        all
#> 6           nbk            3          3   FALSE        BSM
#> 7         bt4pr        FALSE      FALSE   FALSE        BSM
#> 8    ct_MSY.lim         1.21       1.21   FALSE        all
#> 9  q.biomass.pr     0.9, 1.1   0.9, 1.1   FALSE        BSM
#> 10            n         5000       5000   FALSE     charts
#> 11           ni            3          3   FALSE   not used
#> 12          nab            3          3   FALSE        BSM
#> 13           bw            3          3   FALSE        all
#> 14 e.creep.line         TRUE       TRUE   FALSE     charts
#> 15    select.yr           NA         NA   FALSE     output
#> 16     n.chains            2          2   FALSE        all
#> 17       n.iter        60000      60000   FALSE        all
#> 18     n.burnin        30000      30000   FALSE        all
#> 19       n.thin           10         10   FALSE        all
#>                                                                                                                                                                        description
#> 1                                                                                                                        Coefficient of variation of the catch (observation error)
#> 2                                                                                                                               Minimum realistic coefficient of variation of CPUE
#> 3  Not used by CMSY++16.R: the code sets it (sigR <- sigmaR) but never uses it; the model estimates its process error with the prior itau2 ~ dgamma(4, 0.01). It cannot be changed
#> 4                                                                                                                              Correlation of log r and log k, used only in charts
#> 5                                                                                                                                         Beta prior of the r-k correlation plus 1
#> 6                                                                                   Number of B/k priors used by BSM: 1 (first year), 2 (and intermediate year), 3 (and last year)
#> 7                                                                                                                                     Use the abundance data to set the B/k priors
#> 8                                                                                                       Ratio of catch to the MSY prior above which the B/k prior is kept constant
#> 9                                                                                                                             Prior range of q when the abundance data are biomass
#> 10                                                                                                                         Number of points of the r-k cloud in the analysis chart
#> 11                                                                                                Not used by CMSY++16.R: the code sets it but never uses it. It cannot be changed
#> 12                                                                                                                          Minimum number of years with abundance data to run BSM
#> 13                                                                                                                                  Bandwidth of ksmooth() for smoothing the catch
#> 14                                                                                                               Show the CPUE not corrected for effort creep in the biomass chart
#> 15                                                                                                             Year for which B, F, B/Bmsy and F/Fmsy are also reported (NA: none)
#> 16                                                                                                                                                    Number of MCMC chains (JAGS)
#> 17                                                                                                                                      Number of MCMC iterations per chain (JAGS)
#> 18                                                                                                                                             Number of burn-in iterations (JAGS)
#> 19                                                                                                                                              Thinning of the MCMC chains (JAGS)

# Check changed settings before a run: here a larger catch error and longer chains
cmsy_defaults(list(CV.C = 0.2, n.iter = 100000, n.burnin = 50000), lang = "zh")
#>         setting cmsy_default       used changed applies_to
#> 1          CV.C         0.15        0.2    TRUE        all
#> 2       CV.cpue          0.2        0.2   FALSE        BSM
#> 3        sigmaR          0.1        0.1   FALSE   not used
#> 4    cor.log.rk        -0.76      -0.76   FALSE     charts
#> 5   rk.cor.beta   2.52, 3.37 2.52, 3.37   FALSE        all
#> 6           nbk            3          3   FALSE        BSM
#> 7         bt4pr        FALSE      FALSE   FALSE        BSM
#> 8    ct_MSY.lim         1.21       1.21   FALSE        all
#> 9  q.biomass.pr     0.9, 1.1   0.9, 1.1   FALSE        BSM
#> 10            n         5000       5000   FALSE     charts
#> 11           ni            3          3   FALSE   not used
#> 12          nab            3          3   FALSE        BSM
#> 13           bw            3          3   FALSE        all
#> 14 e.creep.line         TRUE       TRUE   FALSE     charts
#> 15    select.yr           NA         NA   FALSE     output
#> 16     n.chains            2          2   FALSE        all
#> 17       n.iter        60000     100000    TRUE        all
#> 18     n.burnin        30000      50000    TRUE        all
#> 19       n.thin           10         10   FALSE        all
#>                                                                                                                  description
#> 1                                                                                                   渔获量观测误差的变异系数
#> 2                                                                                                        CPUE 的最小变异系数
#> 3  CMSY++16.R不使用：代码中有赋值（sigR <- sigmaR），但从未使用；模型的过程误差由先验 itau2 ~ dgamma(4, 0.01) 估计。不能修改
#> 4                                                                                      log r 与 log k 的相关系数，仅用于作图
#> 5                                                                                              r-k 相关系数加 1 的 beta 先验
#> 6                                                           BSM 使用的 B/k 先验个数：1（首年）、2（加中间年）、3（再加末年）
#> 7                                                                                                    用丰度数据设定 B/k 先验
#> 8                                                                          渔获量与 MSY 先验之比超过此值时，B/k 先验保持不变
#> 9                                                                                            丰度数据为生物量时 q 的先验范围
#> 10                                                                                                   分析图中 r-k 点云的点数
#> 11                                                                      CMSY++16.R不使用：代码中有赋值，但从未使用。不能修改
#> 12                                                                                           运行 BSM 所需丰度数据的最少年数
#> 13                                                                                             渔获量平滑（ksmooth()）的带宽
#> 14                                                                   在生物量图中显示未按渔效增长（effort creep）校正的 CPUE
#> 15                                                                 另外报告该年 B、F、B/Bmsy 和 F/Fmsy 的年份（NA 为不报告）
#> 16                                                                                                         MCMC 链数（JAGS）
